verdict.rationale: The only evidence of chat notifications is a Slack integration listed in Vercel's marketplace, which sends messages for comments, deployment status, and new projects. That covers a narrow, fixed set of event triggers. It is not a user-configurable alerting system, and the observability docs describe monitoring with no alert rules or notification channels. missing for 10: user-defined alert conditions or thresholds on metrics, errors or traffic, email delivery, evidence the Slack integration is first-party, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set up alerts that notify me via chat or email when specific conditions are met

citations.quote: Get Slack messages for comments, deployment status, and new projects on Vercel.
